records.claim: Resource Pack overrides can reduce a player's local visual particle workload by suppressing or limiting selected effects; this is a plausible mechanism, not a guaranteed FPS gain or a server-wide optimization.

sources.note: Microsoft Learn documents particle emitters and the max_particles limit; this supports the mechanism and per-emitter limit, not any measured FPS improvement or the hypothetical million-particle scenario.
Repository's static inspection of the two supplied archives; it does not establish runtime performance.

limitations: Documentation supports the particle emitter and per-emitter max_particles mechanism, but does not prove a specific FPS gain.
Other players without the same client-side resource pack may continue rendering their own particle effects; no multiplayer stress test was performed.
No claim is made that one million particles can necessarily be spawned or processed in one point.
No runtime compatibility, multiplayer behavior, FPS or frame-time measurements were performed.
